timeline.evidenceText: In the eighteenth year of king Josiah, the king sent Shaphan, the son of Azaliah the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to Yahweh’s house, saying,
The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;
Their brothers of their fathers’ houses: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber, seven.
Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,
Of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah,
and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house;
and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;

The men did the work faithfully. Their overseers were Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to give direction; and others of the Levites, who were all skillful with musical instruments.
Then sent I for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, for Elnathan, for Jarib, for Elnathan, for Nathan, for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib and for Elnathan, who were teachers.
Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahzeiah the son of Tikvah stood up against this; and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.
Of the sons of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub, and Sheal, Jeremoth.

Next to them, Meremoth the son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz made repairs. Next to them, Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabel made repairs. Next to them, Zadok the son of Baana made repairs.
Joiada the son of Paseah and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah repaired the old gate. They laid its beams, and set up its doors, and its bolts, and its bars.
After him, Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another portion. After him, Meshullam the son of Berechiah made repairs across from his room.
For there were many in Judah sworn to him, because he was the son-in-law of Shecaniah the son of Arah; and his son Jehohanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah as wife.

Ezra the scribe stood on a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam.
Maaziah, Bilgai, and Shemaiah. These were the priests.
Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua,
These are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah.

definitions.short: Meshullam , the name of seventeen Israelites
definitions.full: H4918. Meshullam מְשֻׁלָּם proper name, masculine Μεσουλαμ , Μοσολλαμ , etc.: 1 grandfather of Shaphan 2Kin 22:3 . 2 son of Zerubbabel 1Chr 3:19 . 3 in Benjamin: a. 1Chr 8:17 , perhaps = b. 1Chr 9:7 . c. 1Chr 9:8 . d. Neh 11:7 . 4 in Gad 1Chr 5:13 . 5 wall-builders: a. Neh 3:4 , 30 . b. Neh 3:6 . 6 a chief Neh 10:21 . 7 priests (distinctions in part obscure): a. 1Chr 9:11 ; Neh 11:11 ; 12:13 (perhaps = שַׁלּוּם 11 ). b. 1Chr 9:12 . c. Neh 10:8 . d. Neh 12:6 . e. Neh 12:33 . 8 Levites: a. 2Chr 34:12 . b. Ezra 8:16 ; 10:15 ; Neh 8:14 . c. Neh 12:25 ( = שַׁלּוּם 12a ). 9 Ezra 10:29 . above
